title: Craft Beer 6-pack

drivers.name: Store closed Monday
drivers.evidence: Store closure on Monday reduces expected sales by ~14% (1/7 of week), with no recovery from front-loading given the event's weak historical lift.

adjustment.analysis: The baseline median is 140.8. Thanksgiving (event week) has a noise-adjusted effect of x1.0, so no uplift. The store closure on Monday reduces demand: 1/7 of the week is lost, but sales are likely front-loaded. Given the event's weak historical signal and no promotion, the forecast should not increase. The price is unchanged. No evidence of pantry loading or other demand shift. The classical model's 1.00 is consistent with the noise-adjusted evidence. No drivers justify a multiplier above 1.0.
